How we work together

You share the idea. We handle the rest, and you approve each stage.

  1. Share your idea

    Send your date, venue, budget and any photos or themes you like.

  2. Review the design

    We present a concept and quote. You ask for changes until it feels right.

  3. We build it

    We prepare and produce every piece of your custom styling.

  4. Enjoy your event

    We style the venue on the day so you can focus on your guests.
